plan.sampling: bilinear COLMAP pixel centers minus 0.5; encoded RGB / 255; training observations only
plan.hypothesis: Shared sparse tracks may reveal input color disagreement; sparse matches do not establish diffuse-wall coverage or exposure causation.
plan.protocol_amendment: First audit stopped on duplicate image IDs in tracks. Exclude the entire ambiguous track; validate focus geometry at the same 2px limit and check held-out reference hashes. No thresholds tuned from color results.

scores.interpretation: Observed same-seed variation only; not a confidence interval, causal test or quality acceptance threshold.

input_audit.limitation: Sparse feature colors mix illumination, reflectance, image processing and sampling errors; not an exposure or geometry estimate.
